column1: # The name and comment audit of EA game code: one row per audited function (a later
# row for the same address supersedes an earlier one). Two blind lanes read each function;
# a reconciler compared them with its name and comments. tier: T1 EA text or confirmed
# TW06 name, T2 struct-bound and agreed, T3 agreed guess (fn_<address>_<Guess>), D demoted,
# - no name. decision: kept, renamed, tier3, demoted, unnamed. comments: ok, none,
